answer: Sybil resistance via staked identity: every new agent must lock collateral above a fixed umber line of minimum stake before it can transact. Elected beacon validators audit each identity and slash fakes on detection. Like timber, real economic weight costs real money: spinning up ten thousand fake identities means posting ten thousand bonds. Attackers cannot conjure collateral from nothing, so the linear cost of fake identities exceeds any gain from flooding the network, and honest agents stay cheap to register.
